slides.caption: Linkage
slides.expected: The 100 mm arm and 40 mm anchor give 0.98 N at 45 degrees.

slides.caption: Hand tuning
slides.action: Nudge anchor depth up and apply dimensions.
slides.expected: Depth reads 50 mm. The spring attachment and solid response update together.

slides.caption: Preview alternative
slides.action: Sweep the grid and select the second match.
slides.expected: The preview changes while the comparison retains the hand-tuned dimensions and error.

slides.caption: Apply alternative
slides.action: Repeat the sweep and use the second preview.
slides.expected: The committed fields now match the selected alternative.

slides.caption: Infeasible
slides.action: Select High load and run the same sweep.
slides.expected: The flat 4.8 N target exceeds all admissible matches. Geometry and response are preserved.

slides.caption: Undo
slides.expected: The firm target, chosen geometry and previous response return exactly.
